summary.text: Norm Thurston is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 62 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; he first took office in 2015.
An economist by training, he has worked as a health policy adviser for the State of Utah.

paragraphs.text: Norman "Norm" Thurston earned a B.A. in Spanish and agricultural economics from Brigham Young University in 1990, and an M.A. (1993) and Ph.D. (1995) in economics from Princeton University.

His career experience includes working as a health policy adviser for the State of Utah, the director of the office of healthcare statistics for the Utah Department of Health, and the executive director of the National Association of Health Data Organizations.
Thurston represented Utah House District 64 from 2015 to 2023 and has represented District 62 since 2023.
